Focused pytest across test_medium, test_simulation, hidden-terminal, and jammer-interference passed 90 tests. Focused Ruff on test_medium and test_simulation passed; strict mypy exposes 28 existing test typing errors around Optional Transmission/TDMASlot and one state comparison. Direct runtime edge probes found unmet acceptance in the external class: Medium accepts NaN noise_floor_dbm; start_tx accepts negative time_us, list payloads instead of bytes, NaN positions, negative channel, unknown phy_mode, and negative frequency_hz. It also permits non-monotonic start insertion (a time-100 TX followed by time-0 remains stored as late, early), so monotonic scheduling/lifecycle invariants are unenforced. Node registration, RX timeout delivery, and deterministic event tie ordering live in local Simulation/EventQueue rather than Medium and their focused tests passed, but fixing the Medium input/lifecycle gaps requires changing and releasing lora-medium then repinning LICHEN. No files modified for this bead; claim released.","status":"open"}
